title: Yocan Evolve Plus XL Concentrate Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
The Yocan Evolve Plus XL takes electronic dab pens to a totally new level. With Quad Coil technology and a 1400mAh battery, the XL produces great clouds and great flavour.
Features:
Magnetic Mouthpiece Connection
Adjustable Airflow
QUAD Coil Technology
Removable Silicone Jar
Evolve Plus XL Specifications
Dimensions:
4.72 X 0.75 inches
Battery Capacity:
1400mAh
10 Second Battery Safety Cut-Off
Built-in dual-compartment silicon storage
Evolve Plus XL Kit Includes
1 x Evolve Plus XL Atomizer
1 x Evolve Plus XL 1400mAh Battery
2 x QUAD Quartz Coil (1 Pre-Installed)
1 x Removable Hanging Ring
1 x Lanyard
1 x Micro USB Charging Cable
1 x Loading Tool
